_comment: DESIGN SYSTEM - California Doors and Windows. Drop this file into /CLIENTS/California Doors and Windows/00_intake/brand_assets/design_system.json. Fields marked verified:false should be confirmed before final production but are workable for round 1 prototyping.

zones._comment: Standard ads use 4 zones, NO footer. Flyer mode opt-in only.

zone_1_logo.rendering: Canva composite — image AI never generates logo
zone_1_logo.vector_status: RASTER ONLY — request .svg/.ai/.eps from client before high-res production

zone_2_hero.rendering: AI-generated photo or real photo + headline

zone_3_trust.purpose: Pull-quote OR credential line — ANONYMIZED for round 1
zone_3_trust.anonymization_rule: Use 'San Diego homeowner' / 'Pacific Beach homeowner' / 'Coronado client' — never named individuals until consent collected

palette._comment: From CDW logo + intake brief. HEX values eyedropped from raster logo — flagged unverified until cross-checked against vector or printed asset.

primary.name: CDW Yellow
primary.verification_method_pending: Eyedrop from vector logo OR sample from printed business card

usage_rules.headline_text_color: neutral_dark on light backgrounds, neutral_light on dark/photo backgrounds
usage_rules.background_treatment: photo with brand-color overlay at 0-15% opacity max — preserves photo authenticity

typography._comment: Pulled from intake fonts.txt — flagged unverified until DevTools confirms on live site.

headline.fallback: Any bold serif if Playfair unavailable

photography_mood._comment: Mood derived from logo creative cue (warm, hand-built, Californian craft) NOT from website hero (which uses corporate-showroom imagery). Logo wins; hero loses.
photography_mood.lighting: natural daylight, warm cast, golden-hour preference for exteriors
photography_mood.lens: 35mm or 50mm — avoid wide-angle distortion that signals stock photography
photography_mood.subject_treatment: real people, real worksites, hands-on craftsmanship — never showroom polish
photography_mood.color_grading: warm, slightly desaturated, sun-and-state Californian feel
forbidden: luxury-mansion-only framing (CDW's customers are mid-to-upper-middle-class homeowners, not Beverly Hills only)

compliance.license_placement: Either zone 4 (CTA bar fine print) or zone 1 (under logo strip)
expired_offers_to_avoid: Federal Section 25C Energy Efficient Home Improvement Credit (expired Dec 31, 2025) — DO NOT reference for 2026 creative
live_financial_levers: Monthly energy-bill savings (specific dollar amounts only if Mike confirms)
USDA Single Family Housing Repair Loans for low-income homeowners
compliance.warranty_claim_status: UNVERIFIED — brand-dealer status (Milgard / Anlin / Andersen) not yet confirmed. Avoid specific brand-dealer claims. Generic 'lifetime installation warranty' acceptable IF Mike confirms.
compliance.consent_status: NOT COLLECTED — anonymize all testimonial trust strips for round 1

voice.register: warm, plainspoken, craftsman-direct — NOT polished marketing-agency
voice.register_note: The website hero copy ('Designed to Elevate Your Home', 'Precision-crafted... timeless design') is marketing-agency voice, NOT Mike's voice. Set tone from real customer testimonial cadence instead.
tone_anchors_from_real_customers: Mike was easy to work with
you take the sting out of doing business with dirty contractors
hero_voice_examples_from_reviews: I appreciate your professional and 'no-pressure' approach from the start.
Mike was easy to work with and fair when it came to problems as the work progressed.
Thank you for all you have done for me. You take the sting out of doing business with dirty contractors.
I have dealt with many contractors during my working life, but never had I seen such teamwork as your people.

creative_wedges._comment: Strategic positioning levers locked from intake — every concept should pull from at least one of these.

primary_wedge.name: Mike-as-hero
primary_wedge.rationale: Mike Marohnic is named in the majority of testimonials, has 35+ years CSLB-licensed (since 1988), and competing chains literally cannot replicate him. Mike-led concepts are priority. V1 of every concept defaults to Mike portrait.

secondary_wedge.name: Anti-chain founder positioning
secondary_wedge.rationale: Renewal by Andersen, Window World, Champion, American Vision all have FTC complaints, BBB volume, franchise lawsuits. CDW is family-owned, no franchise, owner-operated. Don't name competitors — contrast implicitly: '35 years, family-owned, no franchise, no high-pressure sales.' The 'no-pressure' phrase appears in customer reviews and is a direct shot at chains' tactics.

tertiary_wedge.name: Coastal Californian craft
tertiary_wedge.rationale: Out-of-state chains can't speak credibly to coastal salt-air durability or Title 24 compliance. CDW operates exclusively in SoCal. Logo's sun-and-state imagery reinforces this.

service_catalog_for_concept_scoping._comment: Confirmed from live site — broader than just doors/windows. Concepts can target any of these but PRIORITIZE windows + doors for round 1 (highest volume + Mike's specialty).
